notes: faces right; floats (anchor = body centre). fly: 6-frame wingbeat loop. perch: standing on a ledge, feet on frame row 24 (8px below the anchor), head bob/peck loop. takeoff: perch -> fly. dive: 0-1 wings flare up/back (1 = held windup, eye glints), 2-4 wings folded, beak-first plunge ~40 deg down-right (engine moves it along that line), 5 wings snap open. death: tumbles, feathers burst, falls and scatters into feathers (engine may let it fall further).
